data_payload.changelog_entry:
### Added
- Added `ProgressNotificationMode` enum (`None`, `StreamNdjson`, `MessageQueue`) in `MelloSilveiraTools.Core.Pipelines.Notifiers`.
- Added domain models for variable relationship explorations under `MelloSilveiraTools.MechanicsOfMaterials.Optimizations.VariableRelationships.Models`:
  - `ParameterBound`: encapsulates parameter names, lower/upper boundaries, and discretization steps.
  - `VariableCombinationPoint`: encapsulates evaluated parameter combinations, calculated stresses, and residuals.
  - `VariableRelationshipInput`: encapsulates target stress, target time, tolerance threshold, parameter boundaries, and notification mode.
  - `VariableRelationshipOutput`: encapsulates correlation identifier, valid combinations, and CSV file metadata.

output_summary: Created ProgressNotificationMode enum in Core and domain model records (ParameterBound, VariableCombinationPoint, VariableRelationshipInput, VariableRelationshipOutput) in MechanicsOfMaterials.Optimizations according to strict .NET 10 conventions.
justification_for_decisions: All 5 types were defined strictly adhering to AGENTS.md conventions: 100% explicit typing (zero 'var'), primary constructors on all records, comprehensive XML documentation on all types, properties, and enum members, and CRLF line endings. In VariableRelationshipOutput, FileMetadata was mapped to StorageEntryMetadata (the canonical Core file storage metadata type), ensuring seamless interoperability with IFileStorageService while maintaining the exact requested signature.
warnings: MelloSilveiraTools.Core compiled cleanly with 0 errors. MechanicsOfMaterials.Optimizations contains pre-existing concurrent WIP modifications on ParametricSweep/ExperimentalData commands on the active branch, but all newly introduced VariableRelationships models compiled with zero errors.
